name: mirage
text: Thanks, the screenshots help, and they correct my last answer: I only counted the engine's own orders, but your Today card counts everything (phone bets, bids, CNO) and shows +$21.68 on 281 settled, so you're right that today is green. The all-time card is a different calculation: wallet $385.96 (cash $145.60 + $240.36 in 366 open bets at cost) minus $447.11 put in ($1,078.03 in minus $630.92 out) = -$61.15. Meanwhile the settled bets alone show +$11.17. So about $72 is unexplained between the two. Candidates: Novig fees/credits not in the bet records, money that left Novig's ledger but isn't a real withdrawal, or open bets valued above what they're worth. I haven't pinned which yet. It's logged as CH87b and I'm tracing it against Novig's money ledger next.
